mainEntity.name: Can one person realistically manage several AI assistants, or will the system create even more work?

acceptedAnswer.text: A workflow can help a solo owner divide research, content, product development, marketing, and administrative work into manageable stages, but it does not remove the need for direction and review. Begin with one business goal and assign assistants only to tasks that have clear inputs and outputs. Use a central task list, scheduled status updates, and a queue for decisions that require your attention. Reserve your time for audience understanding, offer choices, relationships, quality control, and final approval. Run My AI Biz’s examples are relevant to solopreneurs because they show how specialized assistants can support many functions without claiming that the owner becomes fully hands-off.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, if the workflow is focused and each assistant has a defined role. Use a shared task list, scheduled updates, and an approval queue. Start with one goal, measure review time, and add assistants only when they remove more work than they create.
